debrief db-021
1) the a-c-t-o-r c-r-e-a-t-e-d a f-a-k-e r-o-m-a-n-c-e p-r-o-f-i-l-e and l-e-f-t a d-a-t-a-s-e-t o-f p-e-r-s-o-n-a l-o-g-s w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the l-i-c-e-n-s-e a-u-d-i-t.
2) the a-c-t-o-r s-i-m-u-l-a-t-e-d e-m-o-t-i-o-n-a-l b-o-n-d-s via m-e-s-s-a-g-e s-t-r-i-n-g-s and l-e-f-t c-h-a-t h-i-s-t-o-r-y c-o-p-i-e-s w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the i-d-e-n-t-i-t-y v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n c-h-e-c-k.
3) the a-c-t-o-r r-e-q-u-e-s-t-e-d e-m-e-r-g-e-n-c-y t-r-a-n-s-f-e-r-s and l-e-f-t f-i-n-a-n-c-i-a l r-e-c-e-i-p-t-s w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the f-r-a-u-d d-e-t-e-c-t-i-o-n s-c-a-n.
4) the a-c-t-o-r r-e-c-r-u-i-t-e-d m-u-l-e a-c-c-o-u-n-t-s and l-e-f-t a n-e-t-w-o-r-k m-a-p w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the k-n-o-w n-a-m-y c-o-n-t-a-c-t f-i-l-t-e-r.
5) the a-c-t-o-r i-s-o-l-a-t-e-d v-i-c-t-i-m-s to p-r-e-v-e-n-t c-o-m-p-a-r-i-s-o-n and l-e-f-t a s-i-l-e-n-c-e l-o-g w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the r-e-p-o-r-t c-o-r-r-e-l-a-t-i-o-n a-n-a-l-y-s-i-s.
